text: Stomatology is based on the theories of basic medicine, clinical medicine and oral medicine. Through systematic study of core knowledge such as oral anatomy and physiology, oral histopathology, oral internal medicine and oral and maxillofacial surgery, it aims to cultivate professional talents with solid theoretical knowledge, clinical operation skills and professional ethics in stomatology. The core objective is to cultivate high-quality dentists who can engage in the diagnosis and treatment of oral diseases, preventive health care and scientific research in medical and health institutions.
